description: The Mayhem app's window (mayhem.rs, its own EXE): follows the ARAM Mayhem champion select of the League client on this PC (read-only, its password stays in Rust), reads the champion's public stats from arammeta.com and mayhemstats.lol (only the champion's number goes out), the signed-in player's own rank and the leaderboard from mayhemstats.lol (read-only, only the player's own identifier goes out), the augment and champion tier lists with champion details, items and patch changes from arammeta.com (one public list, nothing sent) and the item list from Data Dragon, and writes its errors to the local error log. Opens a champion's guide page on aramonly.com in the browser (aram_open_guide, a fixed address). Updates itself on click (update.rs, as blank.): asks GitHub for the latest release of maltekruse23-oss/blank with its English notes, and only on the install click downloads that release's mayhem.exe from GitHub, checks size and GitHub's SHA-256, replaces the running file and restarts; update_news says once after an update that it should show what is new. When an update of blank. installed this app as blank.exe, it cleans up after blank. once on its own (from_blank.rs) and mayhem_moved only returns the one English line of what was removed; the page cannot start, choose or repeat anything of it. The page cannot name another file or address. Nothing else; no window, filesystem, shell or HTTP permissions.
